title: Light reflected by a sheet of glass, as the back-surface arrow turns
description: Bar chart. Feynman's rule in QED: each surface of the glass contributes an arrow 0.2 long, the front one reversed; the reflected fraction is the square of their sum. As the extra turn of the back arrow goes from 0 to 360 degrees in steps of 45, the reflection is 0, 2.3, 8, 13.7, 16, 13.7, 8, 2.3 and 0 percent. The arithmetic is this frame's.
heading: REFLECTED, % · BY THE BACK ARROW'S EXTRA TURN
